verdict.rationale: Zulip documents a bot framework, a Botserver and integrations. Nothing in the evidence shows a product-level way to version, review or roll back those automations. The API feature-level changelog covers versioning of Zulip's own API, not users' automations, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
